tools.name: describe-index-stats
tools.description: Shows statistics about an index's data, including record counts and available namespaces.

tools.name: create-index-for-model
tools.description: Creates an index that uses an integrated inference model to embed text as vectors.

tools.name: upsert-records
tools.description: Inserts or updates records in an index with integrated inference.

tools.name: search-records
tools.description: Searches an index by text query using integrated inference, with optional metadata filtering and reranking.

tools.name: cascading-search
tools.description: Searches multiple indexes, then deduplicates and reranks the results.

tools.name: rerank-documents
tools.description: Reranks records or text documents with a reranking model.
